retro.help.title: Continuous Improvement
retro.help.intro: Continuous Improvement collects lessons about working better, distilled when substantial chats close. The console proposes; you decide whether to adopt, save or discard each process lesson.
retro.help.first.title: First steps
retro.help.first.step1: Check the number of new proposals on the Continuous Improvement card.
retro.help.first.step2: Tap “Open board” and open a lesson in the “🟡 New” group.
retro.help.first.step3: Read the lesson, its recurrence and the destination suggested by the AI.
retro.help.first.step4: Tap “Adopt” to send it to that destination, “Save” to decide later, or “Discard” if it isn't useful.
retro.help.first.step5: Review adopted lessons: if one happens again, the “recurs” badge lets you escalate it to a stronger destination.

retro.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
retro.help.buttons.refresh.v: Updates the card's badge and counts. It doesn't use tokens.
retro.help.buttons.adopt.v: Promotes the lesson to the suggested destination and marks it adopted.
retro.help.buttons.more.v: Shows other applicable destinations for that lesson.
retro.help.buttons.save.v: Saves it for a later decision without promoting it.
retro.help.buttons.dismiss.v: Moves it to the Discarded group.
retro.help.buttons.reopen.v: Returns a discarded lesson to the proposals group.
retro.help.buttons.acceptAll.v: Bulk-adopts all pending lessons, each to its suggested destination; writes to real destinations.
retro.help.buttons.curate.v: Finds duplicates, contradictions, redundancies and gaps with AI. It uses tokens and every change is decided separately.
retro.help.buttons.email.v: Reads Chris's email, interprets feedback and adds it to the registry. It uses tokens and never sends messages.
retro.help.buttons.teams.v: Reads the Teams chat with Chris, interprets feedback and adds it to the same registry. It uses tokens and never sends messages.
retro.help.buttons.ref.v: Filters the board by that reference to show related feedback.
retro.help.buttons.escalate.v: Appears when an adopted lesson recurs and lets you move it to a stronger destination.
retro.help.buttons.delete.v: Permanently deletes a discarded lesson after asking for confirmation.
retro.help.difference.title: Continuous Improvement and Learning
retro.help.difference.retro.v: The system learns process lessons so future sessions work better.
retro.help.difference.learning.v: Your personal study space for understanding topics and code; it doesn't change process rules.
retro.help.warning.title: Watch out
retro.help.warning.text: Nothing auto-applies. “Adopt” and “Accept all” write to the indicated real destination; review it before confirming. “Delete” permanently removes a discarded lesson. AI searches and curation use tokens.
